name: Barnegat Inlet — North Jetty
orientation_rationale: North jetty opens to ENE (bearing ~75 deg). NE wind is quartering onshore; SW wind is offshore and calms the water behind the jetty. Striper/bluefish blitz on SW outgoing tide.

name: Barnegat Inlet — South Jetty
orientation_rationale: South jetty at Island Beach State Park opens ESE (~105 deg). E/SE wind is onshore, NW wind is offshore. Fluke drift on incoming tide; striper plug on outgoing.

name: Manasquan Inlet — North Jetty
orientation_rationale: North jetty (Point Pleasant Beach) opens due east. NE wind is onshore quartering; W wind is offshore. Classic striper jetty at dawn/dusk.

name: Manasquan Inlet — South Jetty
orientation_rationale: South jetty (Manasquan side) opens due east. Same wind geometry as North jetty but south-side currents on outgoing tide are stronger, favoring heavier plugs.

name: Shark River Inlet — North Jetty
orientation_rationale: Jetty faces nearly due east. NE-E onshore, W offshore. Small inlet, crowded but reliable spring striper.

name: Little Egg Inlet — North
orientation_rationale: Inlet mouth opens ESE (~110 deg). Boat-only access via Great Bay Boulevard WMA; deep channel drift for fluke on incoming.

name: Little Egg Inlet — South
orientation_rationale: South side of Little Egg Inlet against Holgate spit. SE onshore, NW offshore. Known drumfish and weakfish spot in early summer.

name: Island Beach State Park — A7 Pocket
orientation_rationale: Named pocket/bowl on the IBSP ocean side, ENE-facing beach. NE wind stacks bait against the sand bar; SW wind flattens. Top IBSP striper spot in fall run.

name: Island Beach State Park — Gillikin's
orientation_rationale: Named surf pocket on IBSP, east-facing. Same wind geometry as A7. Fluke on the first bar in summer; striper in the trough at dusk.

name: Seaside Heights Pier
orientation_rationale: Casino Pier — due east. Public fishing pier at the end, deep water off the pilings. Bluefish and fluke dominate; striper in shoulder seasons.

name: Holgate Beach — South End
orientation_rationale: South tip of Long Beach Island, LBI. Beach arcs to the SE (~105 deg). Onshore on SE winds, offshore on NW. Quiet 4WD-only access; big striper in fall.

name: Double Creek Channel
orientation_rationale: Deep cut north of Barnegat Inlet backbay — channel runs NE/SW. Drift for fluke on either tide, wind-neutral (protected water).

name: Oyster Creek Channel
orientation_rationale: Warm-water discharge channel north of Oyster Creek nuclear generating station historical location. Winter holdover stripers; summer fluke on the edges.

name: Tices Shoal
orientation_rationale: Broad sand flat on the east side of the bay north of Barnegat Inlet. Classic fluke drift at 3-6 ft. No single orientation.

name: Mantoloking Bridge — South Side
orientation_rationale: Bridge pilings create ambush structure. Striper on incoming tide at dusk. Shore access on the south bulkhead.

name: Forked River Mouth
orientation_rationale: Confluence of Forked River with the bay. Striper stage on incoming; weakfish on the flats nearby in early summer.

name: Toms River Mouth
orientation_rationale: Toms River flushes into northern Barnegat Bay. Striper follow bunker into the mouth in spring; fluke in deeper cuts.

name: Waretown Creek
orientation_rationale: Kayak-only shallow creek off the west bay shore. Weakfish on tide changes; small striper year-round.

name: Stouts Creek
orientation_rationale: Tidal creek draining western Pinelands into the bay. Fluke on the edge drop-off; weakfish on the flat.

name: Cedar Creek Mouth
orientation_rationale: Cedar Creek empties into central Barnegat Bay. Striper hold on the mouth channel on outgoing tide.

name: Great Bay — Seven Islands
orientation_rationale: Back-bay marsh island cluster south of Tuckerton. Shallow flats with drop-offs; fluke drift on the edges.

name: Little Egg Harbor Flats
orientation_rationale: Broad shallow flats between Beach Haven and Tuckerton. Classic fluke drift water on light-wind days.

name: Beach Haven — High Bar Harbor Channel
orientation_rationale: Deep cut through Little Egg Harbor near Beach Haven. Deep drift for big fluke in late June; striper in shoulder seasons.

name: Barnegat Light — Viking Village Bulkhead
orientation_rationale: Commercial bulkhead on Barnegat Light side — inlet current sweeps past. Heavy tidal flow holds bait; big striper at night on slack-outgoing transition.

name: Sedge Islands
orientation_rationale: Sedge-island maze behind Island Beach State Park — kayak access only via IBSP. Striper and weakfish on the flats at dawn.

name: High Bar Harbor Flats
orientation_rationale: Shallow flats on the LBI bayside near High Bar Harbor. Summer fluke drift in light NE wind.

name: Seaside Park — Back Bay Bulkhead
orientation_rationale: Back-bay public bulkhead with shore access. Striper at night on bait; fluke on the channel edge.

name: Metedeconk River Mouth
orientation_rationale: Metedeconk flushes into northern Barnegat Bay. Striper on incoming tide in spring; fluke on the deep edge in summer.

name: Absecon Inlet — North Jetty
orientation_rationale: Absecon Inlet (Atlantic City) north jetty opens ESE (~100 deg). NE wind onshore, W offshore. Direct shore access from Brigantine.

name: Absecon Inlet — South Jetty
orientation_rationale: South jetty at the end of Absecon Inlet inlet park. Opens SE (~110 deg). SE wind onshore, NW offshore. Strong outgoing current holds stripers.
